name: The Fahey Banking Company
summary: Fahey Banking Company offers a comprehensive array of financial products and services. Their diverse selection includes various deposit accounts, such as direct deposit, money market, and business solution checking options, as well as standard, money market, business, and health savings accounts. For retirement planning, they provide Christmas club, business retirement, and individual retirement accounts, alongside certificates of deposit. Beyond deposits, Fahey Banking Company extends a broad spectrum of lending solutions. These encompass home mortgage, home equity, auto, and both personal and business term loans, in addition to commercial real estate and Small Business Administration (SBA) financing. They also facilitate access to funds through home equity and business lines of credit, and offer personal and business credit card options. To enhance convenience, the institution provides modern banking conveniences like bill payment, overdraft protection (bounce protection), ACH services, remote deposit capture, and electronic payment solutions, in addition to merchant services. Customers can manage their finances easily through their online, mobile, and telephone banking platforms. Established in 1865, Fahey Banking Company, originally known as The Bank of Ireland, is headquartered in Marion, Ohio.
